entities.summary: Samuel Robert Denby is an American YouTuber who created the edutainment YouTube channels Wendover Productions and Half as Interesting, and the travel competition show Jet Lag: The Game, alongside other projects. As of February 12, 2026, Denby has accumulated more than 1.7 billion views and over 8.8 million subscribers across all of his YouTube channels. He is the chief content officer of the streaming service Nebula.
